metadata.description: AI-powered learning agent with LangGraph backend and Next.js frontend

files.description: Loads environment variables (GROQ_API_KEY, EXA_API_KEY) and exposes Config singleton
FastAPI application entry point; sets up CORS, includes learning routes, health endpoint
Re-exports runner functions (run_until_interrupt, resume_until_interrupt, AgentInterrupt) for clean imports
Pydantic models for LangGraph state: Resource, FetchedContent, Task, Roadmap, QuizQuestion, State
LangGraph StateGraph definition; wires all nodes and conditional edges for the learning flow
All LangGraph node implementations: roadmap, resource fetching, research, explain, quiz, challenge, project, progress, and routers
Async wrappers around compiled LangGraph graph; handles streaming, interrupts, state injection, and node output capture
In-memory session registry mapping session_id to {state, phase}; thread-safe for single-worker uvicorn
FastMCP tool using ExaSearchRetriever (langchain_exa) to search documentation; exposes search_docs(query)
FastMCP tools for YouTube search (yt_dlp) and transcript fetching (youtube_transcript_api)
Aggregates all MCP tools (search_docs, youtube_search, youtube_transcript) into single FastMCP server
Pydantic request/response schemas for all API endpoints (Start, RoadmapEdit, Next, Quiz, Challenge, Resources, SessionStatus)
All HTTP endpoints (/start, /roadmap/edit, /next, /quiz/start, /quiz/submit, /challenge, /resources, /session); orchestrates graph execution via runner and session_store
Initializes ChatGroq LLM (meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct) using config.GROQ_API_KEY
Next.js 16.2.2 project config with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, react-markdown, ESLint
TypeScript config with strict mode, path aliases (@/*), Next.js plugin
Minimal Next.js config
Root layout with Inter/Manrope fonts, Material Symbols, dark theme, global CSS
Main client component; orchestrates all UI phases (idle, roadmap, lesson, quiz, evaluation, project, finished) using useLearningSession hook
Typed fetch wrappers for all backend endpoints mirroring Pydantic schemas; BASE_URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL

Central state machine (reducer) for all learning flow phases; exposes actions (startSession, modifyRoadmap, confirmRoadmap, goNextLesson, beginQuiz, setAnswer, submitQuiz, resolveChallenge, continueAfterProject)
Collapsible sidebar showing roadmap progress, current task highlight, progress percentage
Top navigation with menu toggle, resource panel toggle, session info
Right-side panel displaying resources for current task (title, type, timestamps, reason)
Individual resource display with link, type badge, video timestamps
Bottom action bar during lesson/quiz phases: Take Quiz / Next Lesson buttons
Chat bubble component for user/assistant messages
Formatted lesson display with title, tags, code snippet, key takeaway, markdown content
Quiz display component (defined but not directly used; page.tsx has inline AnswerForm/EvaluationCard)
Wrapper for Material Symbols Outlined icons
Progress bar component (defined but not directly used)

data_flow.start_session: POST /api/start → run_until_interrupt → roadmap_review interrupt → return roadmap
data_flow.edit_roadmap: POST /api/roadmap/edit → inject_state(user_action) → resume_until_interrupt → if confirm: auto-run to quiz_permission interrupt
data_flow.next_lesson: POST /api/next → inject quiz_permission=False → resume → challenge_prompt → auto-decline → progress → next lesson
data_flow.start_quiz: POST /api/quiz/start → inject quiz_permission=True → resume → quiz_answer interrupt → return questions
data_flow.submit_quiz: POST /api/quiz/submit → inject user_answers → resume → evaluate_quiz → challenge_prompt interrupt → return score/feedback
data_flow.handle_challenge: POST /api/challenge → inject challenge_accepted → resume_capturing_nodes → project_node (if accepted) → progress_node → return project + next lesson data
